title: Provide host-backed POSIX process containment for stopping detached test gates
outcome: Provide host-backed POSIX process containment for stopping detached test gates
acceptance: Define and implement a supported containment capability for POSIX detached test gates, including descendants that create new sessions or process groups; unsupported hosts refuse stop without claiming cleanup.
Tests prove contained detached descendants have exited before interruption is saved or notified, including parent-exit and completion races, while unrelated processes remain alive.
Use the existing interrupted result and notification contract; document required host delegation and platform limits without requiring global changes implicitly.
